row.notes: cxx=GameWeatherSystem::updateRandomSeed. ws+0x1f18 = weekend (log offset weekend*10); base seed ws+0x1f10 = seed unless the forced override ws+0x1f14 is non-zero (then base = forced); pushes base+weekend*10 to TOD *(ws+0x1d98) via TimeOfDaySystem::updateRandomSeed 0x144619cf0 when TOD is set (called twice with the same value, 0x1438c81d0 and 0x1438c8221); writes base to *(0x145f8d6c0)+0x174 and weekend to +0x178 (V0245). Only caller WeatherAndTimeOfDayComponent::setWeatherSystemRandomSeed 0x140bde3e0 (component+0x2c4 rnd_seed, weekend = season current_weekend if valid else 0), which afterwards sets ws+0x1f02/+0x1f04/+0x1f08 itself (a direct call skips those). career-editor no longer calls it directly; it goes through Sess_WeatherComponent_SetSystemRandomSeed.  | std-libs 2026-11-18 (static, forced_seed ws+0x1f14): one game writer, the GameWeatherSystem init 0x1438ad990, which stores 16 zero bytes over +0x1f14..+0x1f23 (vmovups at 0x1438afa84; xmm6 zeroed by vxorps at 0x1438adb6c, nonvolatile, no other xmm6 write before the store). Scanned every disp32 use of +0x1f14 and every store whose width covers it (displacements +0x1ef5..+0x1f14) in the executable sections: the only readers are this function (0x1438c8157), where non-zero replaces base_seed +0x1f10, and GameWeatherSystem::generateNewBaseRandomSeed 0x151a29d70 (read at 0x151a29e37; thunk 0x1438b1330, called from 0x1438b0cc6 and 0x1438b7ede), where non-zero sets m_randSeed and 0 builds a QueryPerformanceCounter millisecond seed; neither writes it. So 0 is no forced seed and only an addon write (Career Mode Editor's pin) makes it non-zero. Steam 1.0.145 (sigport --witness): init 0x1438aff20 1350/1350 equal and this function 0x1438ca670 126/126 equal, +0x1f14 at the same instruction in both; the 1.0.145 scan finds the same three sites (0x1438b2014, 0x1438ca6e7, and 0x15125f567 in generateNewBaseRandomSeed 0x15125f4a0, thunk 0x1438b38c0). The re-bindings blind verify also scanned computed-pointer, sub-object, +0x20 base and whole-object paths: no other writer. Not covered: fully virtualised protector code.
